description:
Turn your music into moving visuals with PulseCanvas Studio. Built for creators on iPhone and iPad, with no account, subscription, advertising or tracking. Your imported music and projects stay on your device.

OPTIMIZED FOR IPHONE DUO
Enjoy a larger visual preview, a full-width Studio timeline and controls that adapt as you fold, unfold or rotate your iPhone Duo. Studio and Radio make the most of the available screen while keeping playback and visualizer controls within reach.

EXPLORE 300+ NATIVE METAL VISUALIZERS
Dive into twisting tunnels, flowing liquid, kinetic sculptures, glowing particles and geometric worlds. Start with the included soundtrack or import your own audio. Choose a palette and shape the motion, depth, zoom and music response. Save favorites with their visual settings, filter by category, and discover a different look with the randomizer.

LISTEN WITH RADIO
Choose a station and let PulseCanvas Radio pair continuous shuffled music with beat-aligned visuals. Save favorite songs, play a favorites station, or shuffle visuals from your favorite effects or a category. Scrub, pause and skip songs, or keep listening in the background while your device is locked. Radio downloads its public station playlist and songs; it does not upload your music or projects.

BUILD YOUR VIDEO IN STUDIO
Arrange beat-aligned scenes with individual bar lengths. Choose an effect for each scene, loop a section, randomize the timeline, or apply shared visual settings across your video. Save your project, reopen it later, and exchange native-visualizer projects with PulseCanvas Studio on Mac.

WATCH FULL SCREEN. EXPORT UP TO 4K60.
Watch your visualizer or Studio timeline full screen. Export an MP4 with the soundtrack included in wide, portrait or square formats, then save it to Files to keep or share. Wide 4K is 3840×2160; portrait 4K is 2160×3840; square is 2160×2160. Frame rates go up to 60 fps. Create a music video, a social post, or a visual backdrop for your next project.

COMPLETELY FREE
No subscriptions, in-app purchases or paid features. Use PulseCanvas Studio freely for personal projects or commercial video work. Source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/protomota/pulsecanvas

Requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 18 or iPadOS 18 or later. Radio requires an internet connection for catalog and song downloads. Project files save settings and soundtrack references; audio files are not embedded. Locate the soundtrack when moving a project between devices. Export time varies with the effect, resolution and device. Use music and other material you have permission to use.
promotionalText: Optimized for iPhone Duo. Explore 300+ music-reactive Metal visualizers, build beat-aligned Studio scenes and export videos up to 4K60. Completely free.
whatsNew:
Optimized for iPhone Duo.

• A larger visual preview and full-width Studio timeline.
• Controls that adapt as you fold, unfold and rotate.
• A roomier Radio view with music and visualizer controls clearly separated.
• Richer color palettes with contrasting accents and blended transitions.
reviewerNotes:
Native iPhone and iPad app using Apple Metal, with 336 active native visualizers. Version 1.2 adds adaptive iPhone Duo layouts: landscape Studio and Radio fit without vertical scrolling, and previews use the full width while controls avoid the side status region. No account or sign-in is required. All features are free, including commercial video creation using the official app. No external visualizer engine, OpenGL preset pack or Sparkle updater is included.

Studio and Radio are selected with the switch at the top left. Studio starts with the bundled demo soundtrack paused; tap Play to hear it and see its visual response. The top-right grid button opens the visualizer library. Search, categories and favorites filter the available effects and randomization. A nonfavorite selection gets randomized visual settings; a saved visualizer favorite restores its saved appearance. Visual style has sliders and Reset to restore defaults.

Studio scenes align to the soundtrack's beat grid. Each timeline card has its own bar length, playback and visualizer selection. Randomize timeline changes visualizers or bar lengths, with a confirmation. Apply to all changes shared visual settings. The presentation icon opens full-screen viewing; tap the visual to reveal playback controls. Hi-hat strobe is optional and off by default. Chaos at zero disables music-driven deformation and pulses while procedural motion may continue. Visualizers can include fast motion and simulated movement.

The top-right three-dot Project actions menu contains Import audio, Open project, Save project, Export MP4 and About & Support. Import audio uses the system Files picker. Projects use the .pulsecanvas format and can exchange native visualizer settings/timelines with the Mac app. Audio is referenced separately, not embedded; locate it when opening a project on another device.

Radio loads public station JSON and music from https://radio.pulsecanvas.si/stations.json with no sign-in. Tap Play to start it, select a station or Favorite songs, use Next song, and scrub/pause with the playback timeline. Song hearts save songs; the separate visualizer heart saves effects and their settings. Favorite songs opens the saved-song list and its Play favorite songs action. The visualizer group picker limits effects to all, favorites or a category; an empty visualizer-favorites filter falls back to random effects. Audio can continue in the background or with the device locked; visual rendering pauses when inactive. No user files, favorites or visual settings are uploaded.

Export MP4 opens export settings for wide, portrait or square video, 720p/1080p/4K and 24/30/60 fps. Render video generates the MP4 with audio and displays frame progress and a time estimate. Save video opens the system Files destination picker. A successful Files save is confirmed; canceled or failed saves do not count as successful exports. There is no Show in Finder action on iOS. Export time depends on the selected effect, resolution and device.

About & Support includes Rate on the App Store, Share PulseCanvas, Send feedback and Legal & Credits. Tip the Developer is shown only when StoreKit reports the USA storefront; unknown/other storefronts omit it. There is no paywall, reward or requested rating score. After the second successful video save, the app can make one native StoreKit review request when idle, without a custom review pre-prompt. Apple controls presentation and suppresses the sheet in TestFlight.

No advertising, tracking, audio recording or user-file upload. Source: https://github.com/protomota/pulsecanvas .
